## About
MVP German Auto Specialist is an independent repair and maintenance shop in Tucker, GA. People bring us newer daily drivers and older German cars that need someone who knows them well.
Reviewers describe us as knowledgeable, transparent and fairly priced, and a few mention Justin and Corie by name. We'd like to be the shop you keep coming back to.

## Services
- Post purchase inspection: Just bought a car? We'll look it over and give you a general health check so you know where things stand.
- Oil change: Routine oil service to keep your car running the way it should.
- Maintenance: Scheduled maintenance and jobs like front wheel bearing replacement.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you only work on German cars?
A: German cars are our focus, but one reviewer's family brings us a Volvo, a Lexus and a Chevrolet. Give us a call and ask about yours.

Q: Will you tell me if an aftermarket part makes more sense?
A: Yes. One reviewer said we explain when an OEM part or an aftermarket option is the better fit for the car.
